name: Awtomic
long_description: Awtomic powers DTC brands with an easy-to-use subscription management and discovery platform. Starting with a Shopify app, we'll give merchants the subscription product power of premium subscription brands like Dollar Shave Club and Ipsy. As we grow our support for more eCommerce platforms and merchants, we'll help customers discover new brands through cross-sells and make it easier for them to manage their subscriptions in one place.
one_liner: Dollar Shave Club as a platform.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: As.a Product leader, I've worked on a breadth of problems, including building a cross-platform Checkout flow for Eventbrite, automating tour scheduling for Redfin and launching Xbox One. Bundle originated from a desire to help my sister, who founded a DTC beauty brand and was frustrated by the many limitations of her subscription app.
